geometry: part.step is an unchanged copy of input plate.step, two 0.1 mm extruded solids. FEM is the z=0 cross-section. Geometry vertices are read from CAD. No 0.1 mm thickness factor enters G per unit thickness.
formulation: Small-strain linear isotropic plane stress, conforming six-node triangles with quadratic displacement and affine geometry. Quadrature order 6. Direct sparse solve (scipy SuperLU). lambda_ps=E nu/(1-nu^2), mu=E/(2(1+nu)).

boundary_conditions.bottom: uy=0 at y=-4; ux free except bottom-left
boundary_conditions.crack: Two independent coincident curves, separate nodes/displacements except shared tip nodes. Both crack faces traction-free. No contact.
boundary_conditions.bonded_interface: Shared mesh nodes and P2 edge DOFs outside the crack, guaranteeing perfect bond.

quantity_extraction.equation: G = integral_A [sigma_ij (du_i/ds) - W e_j] q_,j dA, e = outward tangent to the interface from each tip, W = 0.5 sigma:epsilon.
quantity_extraction.q: Radial q=1 within rin; q=1-3t^2+2t^3 with t=(r-rin)/(rout-rin) in annulus; q=0 beyond rout. Exact analytical gradient evaluated at quadrature points.
quantity_extraction.interface_terms: No additional material-gradient term is needed: the virtual crack advance direction e is tangent to the straight interface; elasticity is constant along that direction. Bonded interface contributions cancel; traction-free crack has n dot e=0.
quantity_extraction.reported: Mean of finest-mesh rings [0.20,0.40] and [0.30,0.60] mm. Five rings checked independently for path independence. Left advance direction is negative interface tangent; right is positive.
quantity_extraction.conversion: Calculated integral in MPa mm = N/mm, multiplied by 1000 for J/m^2.

field_schema.node_ids: N int64 IDs in mesh.msh, one based; row order for all nodal arrays.
field_schema.coordinates_mm: N x 3, z=0, includes quadratic midside nodes.
field_schema.triangle6_node_ids: T x 6 IDs (v0,v1,v2,mid01,mid12,mid20); actual FEM connectivity, same as MSH.
field_schema.element_ids: T one-based element IDs in mesh.msh. Point and line elements precede triangles.
field_schema.source_gmsh_triangle_ids: Original linear Gmsh triangle tags before deterministic quadratic-node export; diagnostic only.
field_schema.material_id: T array, 1 upper stiff or 2 lower compliant, matches physical group.
field_schema.displacement_mm: N x 2, ux,uy at P2 nodes.
field_schema.prescribed_displacement_mask: N x 2 Boolean mask of zero displacement constraints.
field_schema.boundary_masks: N x 6 Boolean columns for physical line groups 11,12,13,14,15,16.
field_schema.quadrature_coordinates_mm: T x Q x 2. Evaluation coordinates of FEM integration points.
field_schema.quadrature_weights_mm2: T x Q. Physical area weights.
field_schema.strain_at_quadrature: T x Q x 2 x 2 tensor strain, dimensionless; not engineering shear.
field_schema.stress_at_quadrature_MPa: T x Q x 2 x 2 Cauchy stress, sigma_zz=0 by plane stress.
field_schema.forces_N_per_unit_thickness: N x 2 consistent applied forces, integrated using numerical thickness=1 mm.
field_schema.reactions_N_per_unit_thickness: N x 2 residual K u-f, reactions at constrained components; near zero on free DOFs.
field_schema.J_integrals_J_per_m2: 2 x 5, rows right tip,left tip; columns ring order.
field_schema.integral_annulus_masks: 2 x 5 x T x Q, masks of integration annuli.
field_schema.load_factor: [1.0], one static load state. No physical time dependence.
field_schema.*_unit: Unicode scalar unit metadata, no object arrays.

limitations: No contact between crack faces (as specified).
J convergence assessed with independent mesh resolutions and finite annuli; no singular crack-tip enrichment or extrapolation used.
Small-strain, plane-stress idealization; exchange-solid thickness is not a physical multiplier on reported G.
